  "pros": [
    "Generous free tier with essential features",
    "Open-source and strong security posture",
    "Cross-platform availability and browser integration",
    "Easy and quick creation of basic login/note entries",
    "Option for self-hosting for ultimate data control",
    "Comprehensive item types including SSH keys and secure notes"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "UI/UX can feel less polished or intuitive than competitors",
    "Separation of personal vault and organization admin console",
    "Limited free organization features (e.g., 2 users, 2 collections)",
    "Custom fields and advanced options can be less discoverable",
    "Occasional autofill inconsistencies in browser extensions",
    "Steeper learning curve for advanced organization sharing"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.5
}
